c1.note: Accenture's leadership page and later releases list Dr. Marc Warner as Global CTO; no sign of a successor.

c2.note: Accenture's release dated March 16, 2026 announces completion of the Faculty acquisition.

c3.note: The release says Warner expands his role to also become Accenture CTO once the acquisition completed.

c4.note: The September 2026 release and the leadership page both still list him as CEO of Faculty.

c5.note: The release calls him Faculty CEO and co-founder and Faculty a UK-based AI company, with a London dateline.

c6.note: His title combines Accenture CTO and Faculty CEO; the release says he 'expands his role'.

c7.note: The leadership bio says he is a member of the Global Management Committee.

c8.note: The release says he became CTO and joined the committee together once the acquisition completed.

c9.note: The page heading reads exactly 'Chief Technology Officer, Accenture and Chief Executive Officer, Faculty'.

c10.note: The Sept 18, 2026 release quotes 'Dr. Marc Warner, chief technology officer, Accenture and CEO, Faculty'.

c11.note: The article, dated March 17, 2026, says Accenture appointed Warner CTO after the Faculty acquisition completed.

c12.note: The October 17, 2026 article calls Warner Accenture's CTO and covers his Fortune Brainstorm AI remarks, confirming he is still CTO.

c13.note: Sweet is quoted saying she looks forward to working with 'our new CTO Marc Warner' on technology strategy and talent.

c14.note: Prasad was named CTO in 2025 and Warner took the CTO title in 2026; Prasad still leads Technology, and the sources do not state outright that Warner succeeded him.

c15.note: The release names Prasad Group Chief Executive—Technology and CTO; the June 20, 2025 date is from memory, not shown in the passage.

c16.note: The 2025 release describes Prasad as Accenture's Chief Information and Asset Engineering Officer before the technology role.

c17.note: The release says Prasad succeeds Karthik Narain, who decided to leave Accenture.

c18.note: Prasad leads Technology in the March 2026 announcement and Warner became CTO, so Prasad holds the group technology role without the CTO title; nothing in the passages shows he has left it since.

c20.note: The announcement lists Technology led by Rajendra Prasad without calling him CTO; the 'three Reinvention Engines' and March 13 date are not visible in the passages but are plausible.

c19.note: I found no news outlet doing this. Accenture's own Finland bio page still lists Prasad as CTO, which fits stale listings after Warner became CTO on March 16, 2026. The 'outlets' wording itself is unproven.

c21.note: The page I fetched gives Prasad's title as 'Group Chief Executive – Technology and Chief Technology Officer'. Accenture's newsroom says Warner assumed the CTO role on March 16, 2026, so the page is stale.

c3.note: Accenture's March 16, 2026 release on completing the Faculty deal says Faculty CEO Marc Warner 'expands his role to also become chief technology officer of Accenture.' His current Accenture leadership page lists him as Global CTO, and no later change was found.

c14.note: Accenture's 2025 growth-model release named Rajendra Prasad Group Chief Executive–Technology and CTO, succeeding Karthik Narain. MarketScreener shows his CTO role ending 2026-03-15, the day before Warner took over. No source directly calls him Warner's predecessor, so this rests on those dates.
